name: California
licensingAuthorityNote: Contractor licenses in California, including the C-20 (HVAC) and C-36 (Plumbing) classifications, are issued by the Contractors State License Board (CSLB). Registered nurses are licensed by the Board of Registered Nursing.

faqs.question: Does California have contractor license reciprocity with other states?
faqs.answer: Only in limited cases. CSLB's Reciprocity Requirements page offers reciprocity to contractors from Arizona, Louisiana, Mississippi, Nevada, and North Carolina, in a classification on that state's reciprocal list, plus a NASCLA exam waiver for the General Building classification for contractors from any state. Other applicants complete CSLB's Application for Original Contractor's License.
